item1.question: Is PhysioGuidance accredited by SCFHS?
item1.answer: Yes, we are a fully accredited provider. All our CME courses are recognized by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties.

item2.question: How do I upload my CME hours to Mumaris Plus?
item2.answer: We handle this for you! Once you pass the course, our system automatically reports your hours to Mumaris Plus within 48 hours. Please ensure your SCFHS license number is correct in your profile.

item3.question: My name is spelled wrong on my certificate. How do I fix it?
item3.answer: Your certificate uses the name exactly as it appears in your profile. You can edit your profile settings before generating the certificate. If it's already generated, please contact support.

generalTerms.label: 1. General Terms
generalTerms.title: 1. General Terms
generalTerms.content: PhysioGuidance is committed to providing high-quality medical education in compliance with the National eLearning Center (NELC) and the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS). By enrolling in our courses, learners agree to abide by the policies outlined below. These policies are subject to updates in accordance with the regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

attendancePolicy.label: 2. Attendance Policy
attendancePolicy.title: 2. Attendance Policy (CME Requirements)
attendancePolicy.intro: To ensure the integrity of Continuing Medical Education (CME) hours, attendance monitoring is strictly enforced:

items.item1: Live Online Courses: Learners must attend at least 80% of the live session duration to qualify for a certificate. Attendance is tracked automatically via system logs.
items.item2: Recorded Training Courses: Learners must view 100% of the video content and complete all interactive modules.
items.item3: Failure to Attend: If the minimum attendance is not met, the learner will not be eligible for CME hours and must retake the course.

assessment.label: 3. Assessment & Grades
assessment.title: 3. Assessment & Grades
assessment.passingGrade: Passing Grade: A minimum score of 70% on the final assessment is required to generate a completion certificate.
assessment.retakePolicy: Retake Policy: Learners are granted three (3) attempts to pass the final exam. If the learner fails all three attempts, they must re-enroll in the course to reset their progress.
assessment.feedback: Feedback: Formative feedback is provided immediately after exam submission to facilitate learning retention.

academicIntegrity.label: 4. Academic Integrity
academicIntegrity.title: 4. Academic Integrity
academicIntegrity.intro: PhysioGuidance enforces a zero-tolerance policy towards academic dishonesty.

items.item1: Identity Verification: Learners must use their SCFHS license number and legal name. Impersonation is a violation of Saudi law.
items.item2: Plagiarism & Cheating: Any attempt to manipulate assessment results or share exam answers will result in immediate account suspension and cancellation of any certificates issued.

intellectualProperty.label: 5. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.title: 5. Intellectual Property Rights
intellectualProperty.intro: All course materials, including videos, slides, PDFs, and assessments, are the exclusive property of PhysioGuidance and its instructors.

items.item1: Usage: Materials are intended for personal educational use only.
items.item2: Distribution: Unauthorized recording, reproduction, or sharing of course content on public platforms is strictly prohibited and subject to legal action under Saudi intellectual property laws.

refundPolicy.label: 6. Cancellation & Refunds
refundPolicy.title: 6. Cancellation & Refund Policy
refundPolicy.courseCancel: Course Cancellation: If PhysioGuidance cancels a live training course, learners are entitled to a 100% refund or credit for future courses.

items.item1: Self-paced Training Courses: Refunds are available within 48 hours of purchase, provided the learner has not accessed more than 10% of the content or attempted the final exam.
items.item2: Live Training Courses: Refunds are available up to 3 days before the start date. No refunds will be issued for "no-shows".

technicalRequirements.label: 7. Technical Requirements
technicalRequirements.title: 7. Technical Requirements
technicalRequirements.intro: To ensure a smooth learning experience, learners must have:

items.item1: A stable internet connection (download speed of at least 2 Mbps).
items.item2: A compatible device (desktop, laptop, or tablet) with an updated web browser (Chrome, Safari, or Edge).
items.item3: Speakers or headphones for audio content.

privacyData.label: 8. Privacy & Data Protection
privacyData.title: 8. Privacy & Data Protection
privacyData.intro: We adhere to the national data management policies issued by SDAIA (Saudi Data & AI Authority).

items.item1: Data Usage: Your personal data (name, license number, and email) is shared strictly with SCFHS (Mumaris Plus) for the purpose of recording CME hours.
items.item2: Confidentiality: We do not sell or share your data with third-party advertisers.

introduction.label: 1. Introduction
introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to PhysioGuidance. By accessing our website, enrolling in courses, or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must discontinue use of our platform immediately. These terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and PhysioGuidance, headquartered in Saudi Arabia.

medicalDisclaimer.label: 2. Medical Disclaimer
medicalDisclaimer.title: 2. Medical Disclaimer
medicalDisclaimer.intro: PhysioGuidance provides educational content for professional development and exam preparation only.

items.item1: Not Medical Advice: The information provided in our courses is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
items.item2: Professional Judgment: Healthcare practitioners are responsible for exercising their own clinical judgment when applying learned concepts to patient care. PhysioGuidance is not liable for any medical errors or adverse patient outcomes resulting from the application of our training.

userAccounts.label: 3. User Accounts & Security
userAccounts.title: 3. User Accounts & Security
userAccounts.accountResponsibility: Account Responsibility: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. You are strictly prohibited from sharing your account with others.
userAccounts.oneUserOneAccount: One User, One Account: Accounts are non-transferable. Buying a course gives you the license to view it; you cannot "share" the license with colleagues.
userAccounts.unauthorizedAccess: Unauthorized Access: You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

payments.label: 4. Payments & VAT
payments.title: 4. Payments & VAT
payments.currency: Currency: All transactions are processed in Saudi Riyals (SAR).
payments.vat: VAT: In accordance with the regulations of the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA), a Value Added Tax (VAT) of 15% is applicable to all purchases unless otherwise stated.
payments.paymentMethods: Payment Methods: We accept payments via Mada, Visa, MasterCard, Apple Pay, and STC Pay. Access to course material is granted only after successful payment confirmation.

intellectualProperty.title: 5. Intellectual Property Rights
intellectualProperty.intro: The PhysioGuidance platform, including its logo, source code, text, graphics, and course videos, is the property of PhysioGuidance and is protected by Saudi Intellectual Property Authority (SIPA) laws.

items.item1: Restrictions: You may not modify, publish, transmit, participate in the transfer or sale of, reproduce, create derivative works from, or in any way exploit any of the content, in whole or in part.

limitation.label: 6. Limitation of Liability
limitation.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
limitation.intro: To the fullest extent permitted by Saudi law:

items.item1: PhysioGuidance shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of the use or inability to use our services.
items.item2: We do not guarantee that the platform will be error-free or uninterrupted. We reserve the right to perform scheduled maintenance.
items.item3: We are not responsible for the acceptance or rejection of CME hours by international bodies outside of the SCFHS, though we strive to maintain full accreditation.

termination.label: 7. Termination of Use
termination.title: 7. Termination of Use
termination.content: PhysioGuidance reserves the right to suspend or terminate your account at our sole discretion, without notice, for conduct that we believe violates these Terms & Conditions or is harmful to other users, us, or third parties, or for any other reason.

governingLaw.label: 8. Governing Law
governingLaw.title: 8. Governing Law
governingLaw.content: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Any disputes arising under or in connection with these Terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

contact.label: 9. Contact Information
contact.title: 9. Contact Information
contact.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting to the website. Your continued use of the Service following the posting of changes constitutes your acceptance of those changes.
